BreakdownLine.description: One filing row that makes up an input total.

amount.description: Row amount in full currency units, as printed.

citation_check.description:
MATCH: the citation quotes the printed figure. NO_FIGURE: it quotes no amount. MISMATCH: it quotes other figures; check the row. Null when there is no printed figure.

* `NO_FIGURE` - NO_FIGURE
* `MISMATCH` - MISMATCH

counted_amount.description: Signed contribution to the total (negative when deducted, 0 when excluded).

edited.description: An analyst corrected this row's counted amount.

explanation.description: Note wording explaining what the balance is or why it is restricted.

label.description: Row label as printed in the filing.

line_item.description: Template category, e.g. CASH_AT_BANK or IMPAIRMENT_ALLOWANCE.

note.description: Note to the accounts, e.g. Note 18.

page.description: Page in the original filing PDF.

printed.description: Figure as printed in the filing, before scale, e.g. (137,870).

scale.description: Multiplier from the printed figure to full units, e.g. 1000.

treatment.description:
ADDED and DEDUCTED rows reach the total; EXCLUDED rows are shown for transparency only.

* `DEDUCTED` - DEDUCTED
* `EXCLUDED` - EXCLUDED

A screening input with its typed line-item breakdown.

compatibility; prefer ``basis``, ``reconciliation``, ``lines`` and

``ignored_lines``; otherwise it is null.

impure_income_denominator.description:
Input the impure income ratio was divided by.

* `total_income` - total_income

FilingRatios.description: A filing's screening ratios, with each screen's limit and result.

investment.description: Cash and interest-bearing securities / market cap.

IgnoredLine.description: A row returned by extraction but not counted (subtotal, total, maturity split...).

printed.description: Figure as printed in the filing, before scale, e.g. (137,870).

scale.description: Multiplier from the printed figure to full units, e.g. 1000.

MATCHES; ADJUSTED (difference fully explained by the adjustments); UNRECONCILED (needs review); NO_STATEMENT_TOTAL.

* `ADJUSTED` - ADJUSTED

effect.description: Positive: added beyond the printed total. Negative: removed from it.
